About Black Forest Labs
We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.
Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.
Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.
 
Why This Role
We develop AI models and run the infrastructure on which those models are trained, deployed, and served to customers. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on security engineer to protect how our staff work: the accounts they sign in with, the devices they use, the third-party tools they rely on, and the agents they delegate work to. You'll work closely with IT, which operates our employee services and devices.
This is an engineering role: you'll spend your time building tools and automations, designing practical controls, investigating escalations, and shipping changes.
 
What You’ll Work On
These are the areas this role draws from; you're not expected to cover
them all at once:
• 
Identity and access. Strengthen how staff authenticate and what they can reach: single sign-on coverage, phishing-resistant authentication, and access provisioning and revocation that stay reliable and complete as people and tools change. Design scoped, short-lived credentials for the tools and agents that act on staff's behalf, and improve our ability to detect credential misuse.
• 
Endpoint security. Work with IT on device trust, hardening, and visibility across our fleet. Find practical ways for engineers and researchers to install what they need without introducing unnecessary risk.
• 
AI agents and staff tooling. Help staff use agents and AI-powered tools productively and safely. Review the threat models, permissions, and data flows of tools staff build or adopt, including coding agents, desktop assistants, browser extensions, and MCP servers. This includes how staff supervise and stay accountable for delegated actions, and the audit trails that make agent activity reviewable. Build sandboxes, credential patterns, and guardrails that make the secure path the convenient one.
• 
Third-party tool security. Define a scalable security review for the tools staff use day to day, and work with IT, which owns procurement and provisioning, to build security checks into how tools are onboarded and offboarded. Maintain a current picture of which tools can reach company code, credentials, and customer data as tools are added and retired.
• 
Visibility and response. Make sure identity, endpoint, and SaaS telemetry is collected and usable. Investigate escalations and incidents in these areas, verify that we can contain a compromised account or device quickly, and turn findings into lasting fixes.
What We’re Looking For
• 
Strong experience in identity and access security and endpoint security. Hands-on experience administering an identity provider and a device-management platform.
• 
Practical understanding of OAuth, OIDC, SAML, secrets handling, and authorization design. You can trace how an application obtains and uses credentials and find where access controls can be bypassed.
• 
Hands-on engineering ability. You can read unfamiliar code, inspect how an app talks to APIs, and write the automation and tooling that replace manual processes.
• 
Experience using LLMs and agents in your own work, along with a clear-eyed view of where they help, where they don't, and how they can be attacked or misused.
• 
Good security judgment. You can distinguish meaningful risks from theoretical ones and apply controls in proportion to the risk.
• 
Experience supporting researchers, engineers, or other highly technical staff, and a track record of finding secure ways to meet their needs.
• 
Comfort working with real autonomy and turning loosely defined problems into concrete improvements.
Experience with macOS security, developer tooling, SaaS security, software distribution, agent integrations, or threat hunting would be particularly relevant, but none is a prerequisite. We're more interested in people who have solved difficult security problems for real users than in candidates who can check every box on a technology list.
 
How We Work Together
We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in San Francisco, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.
Everything we do is grounded in four values:
• 
Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.
• 
Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.
• 
Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.
• 
Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.
If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.
Base Annual Salary:
US $180,000 - $225,000 USD + Equity
 
Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

6sense is looking for an IT Support Specialist who is passionate about delivering exceptional employee experiences through world-class IT support. You'll support a global workforce while helping improve IT operations through automation, documentation, and process improvement. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and creating scalable solutions that make employees more productive.

• Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support through tickets, chat, email, and remote support sessions.

• Support macOS, Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Teams, Slack, and Zoom environments.

• Manage user lifecycle processes including onboarding, offboarding, access requests, and role changes.

• 3+ years of experience in IT Support, Help Desk, Service Desk, or End User Computing.

• Experience supporting macOS and Windows environments.

• Familiarity with identity and access management concepts including Okta, Entra ID, SSO, and MFA.

• Experience with endpoint management tools such as Intune, Iru, or similar MDM platforms.

• Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer service skills.

• Experience working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

• Basic scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Workato, or similar tools.

• Interest in AI technologies such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude.

• Strong attention to detail, ownership, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Bonus Points

• Experience administering Okta, Entra ID, Intune, or Iru.

• Experience with Workato or workflow automation platforms.

• Experience supporting AI platforms and governance practices.

• ITIL, Okta, Microsoft, Apple, or security-related certifications.

• Experience supporting executive stakeholders and globally distributed teams.

Success in This Role

You'll thrive in this role if you're customer-obsessed, highly organized, technically curious, and motivated to improve how IT services are delivered. Success will be measured through service quality, SLA performance, knowledge sharing, asset management accuracy, and contributions to automation and process improvement.

About the Role

Descript helps creators and companies tell stories through video. The creative team ensures that our brand lives up to the ethos of our customers. We ship work that’s brave, creative, and a bit uncomfortable, pushing with conviction where human creativity matters.

As the Brand Design Lead, you will evolve the brand as you create for campaigns, web experiences, and events. You’ll move between big picture concepting, building brand systems, and designing with an expert level of craft. Reporting to the Director of Brand & Content, you will be trusted and supported to create daring work that reminds people of the joy of telling stories.

What You'll Do

• Set a high bar and execute work that exceeds it

• Evolve and extend the Descript brand to show up well in campaigns, web, and events

• Lead concept and design for launches and campaigns, from brief through delivery

• Build a brand system that scales

• Develop brand systems and toolkits that allow the work to scale in expected (and some unexpected) ways

• Enable product, marketing, and sales partners to create on-brand assets without relying on you

• Multiply your creative impact

• Use AI tools and processes to deliver scale without compromising quality

• Direct internal and external creative partners from illustrators to design engineers

• Mentor designers around you and be an ambassador for your craft around the company

What You Bring

• Minimum Qualifications

• 6+ years in brand design, in-house or agency

• Portfolio showcasing a range of both strategic thinking and executional craft across web, social, and paid channels

• Strong command of typography, color, and composition

• Evidence of building a brand system that scaled beyond your output

• Experience directing outside creative partners

• Fluency with AI tools to produce and scale work alongside a clear perspective of where not to use them

• Preferred Qualifications

• Brand work within a SaaS company (especially the creative software space)

• Motion, front-end dev, or illustration skills

• Experience creating generative brand tooling

• Comfort with being on camera and sharing your work publicly

Success In This Role

First 12 months:

• Our identity feels evolved because you challenged it, pushed it, and fought for something outside any project brief you were given

• You launched a brand campaign that did numbers in your ex-coworker group chat (hopefully for good, but that’s not guaranteed)

• Sure, the Descript website is more on brand and converts well, but there are also immersive moments you are genuinely proud of pulling off

• You regularly spend time with people around the company you never thought you’d be collaborating with

• You shipped something you weren’t proud of, picked yourself up and learned from it

• There’s some Descript merch around you that you actually want

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $185,000. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, level, and may vary from the amount above.

Descript is building a simple, intuitive, fully-powered editing tool for video and audio — an editing tool built for the age of AI. We are a team of 150 and the backing of some of the world's greatest investors (OpenAI, Andreessen Horowitz, Redpoint Ventures, Spark Capital). 

Descript is the special company that's in possession of both product market fit and the raw materials (passionate user community, great product, large market) for growth, but is still early enough that each new employee has a measurable influence on the direction of the company.

Benefits include a generous healthcare package, 401k matching program, catered lunches, and flexible vacation time. Our headquarters are located in the Mission District of San Francisco, CA. We're hiring for a mix of remote roles and hybrid roles.  For those who are remote, we have a handful of opportunities throughout the year for in person collaboration.  For our hybrid roles, we're flexible, and you're an adult—we don't expect or mandate that you're in the office every day. Descript is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We believe in actively building a team rich in diverse backgrounds, experiences, and opinions to better allow our employees, products, and community to thrive.

f9fab0771d0ace0d.description: Tutcart is building products that help learners, families, tutors and education partners connect and get things done. We’re a startup: priorities move quickly, the problems are real, and there’s room to shape how things work. We’re looking for a curious, entrepreneurial QA Engineer who sees quality as a team sport and a product advantage. You’ll help us ship with confidence while building the habits, tools and automation that let a small team move fast. The opportunity This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You’ll wear multiple hats: explore the product, pressure-test new ideas, write focused checks, investigate production issues, improve release habits and help the team decide what quality means for each change. You’ll work closely with engineering, product and operations, jump into unfamiliar areas, and turn ambiguity into a clear next step. What you’ll do - Test real end-to-end journeys across web and mobile, including sign-up, discovery, booking, scheduling, payments and communication. Look beyond happy paths to permissions, state transitions, edge cases and recovery. - Join early in discovery and delivery: ask sharp questions, clarify acceptance criteria, identify risk and suggest simpler or safer approaches before code is finished. - Build the right level of coverage for the risk, combining thoughtful exploratory testing with maintainable UI, API and lower-level automated checks. - Reproduce and explain issues clearly, using concise steps, expected and actual behavior, environment details and evidence. Help engineers get from report to root cause quickly. - Own quality improvements end to end: strengthen regression checks, improve CI feedback, spot patterns in customer feedback and production signals, and close the loop after incidents. - Adapt as the company grows. Pick up adjacent work, unblock teammates and improve lightweight processes without creating ceremony for its own sake. - Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools to speed up test design, generate data, explore scenarios, analyze failures and maintain automation. Validate their output critically, protect sensitive data and keep human judgment accountable for release confidence. What you bring - Experience testing and shipping web products, with strong exploratory instincts and a practical automation mindset. - A builder’s attitude: you take initiative, are comfortable with ambiguity, and turn challenges into experiments and measurable improvements. - Good product judgment: you can prioritize by user impact and risk, and explain trade-offs clearly in a fast-moving environment. - Experience with browser developer tools and API testing; working knowledge of an automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress or Selenium. - Clear written communication and a habit of making findings reproducible and useful to the whole team. - Curiosity about AI-assisted and agentic workflows, plus the discipline to verify results rather than trust generated output blindly. Bonus points - You’ve helped establish QA practices at a startup or small product team. - You’ve tested marketplace, education, scheduling, payments or communication products. - Familiarity with SQL, CI pipelines, mobile testing, accessibility or observability. You’ll thrive here if you like moving from a customer problem to a test idea to a shipped improvement, enjoy learning outside a narrow job description, and take pride in helping a team move quickly without losing sight of users. This is a full-time role with the option to work in office or remotely. To apply, share an example of a tricky quality problem you owned: how you found it, what you tried, and what improved as a result.

Headquarters: Remote, United Kingdom

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
The Role

We are seeking a highly driven, strategic, and consultative Account Executive to lead the full sales cycle and drive new business growth across our strategic Enterprise accounts in the UK. 

This patch is a net-new logo hunter's playground. The territory spans some of the most demanding, deep-pocketed accounts in the UK: global quant trading houses and hedge funds where milliseconds and data integrity define competitive edge, systemically important financial institutions and asset managers with balance sheets in the hundreds of billions, a Big Four professional services giant, a global advertising and marketing holding company, and a mix of consumer and industrial brands with complex, multi-region infrastructure needs. These are organisations where data is the business - where how it's managed, moved, protected and put to work determines whether they win or lose. None of them are customers today. That's the opportunity: a blank sheet, a strategic account list built for someone who wants to build relationships from zero, navigate sophisticated buying committees, and win logos by solving real data management problems -  not inherit a book and defend it.

What You'll Do

• Drive business growth by leading the full enterprise sales cycle, from strategic prospecting to consistently exceeding sales quotas.

• Apply solution and consultative selling to uncover business challenges using data and co-create tailored solutions focused on measurable customer outcomes.

• Develop multi-level, trusted relationships to secure and sustain executive access and engagement for maximum enterprise impact on key accounts.

• Execute strategic account management and account expansion (cross-sell/upsell/new logos) by developing and maintaining multi-year plans for high-value customers.

• Ensure operational excellence and consistent execution by managing sales systems, leveraging tools, and proactively collaborating with internal teams and external partners.

What You'll Bring

• Demonstrated success in direct and indirect enterprise accounts, with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quotas.

• A strong 'sales hunter' mentality, with a relentless focus on proactive new logo acquisition and identifying high-potential opportunities.

• Expertise in strategic account management disciplines, including deep account planning and relationship building across all organizational levels.

• A robust background in consultative selling, leading discussions with unique insights and building business cases tied to measurable outcomes (ROI, TCO).

• Proven ability to acquire new customers and drive account expansion by identifying white space and effectively leveraging channel partner relationships.

• A deep understanding of the storage industry, cloud computing, and modern data center architecture.

• High level of motivation and intrinsic drive, including emotional intelligence, strategic mindset, and accountability for delivering results.

• Business proficiency in English. 

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

• Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

• Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

• Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Join us and bring your best.

Bring your bold.

Pure and simple.
